01 / The gap

Most companies do not have an IT department. They have someone who happens to handle IT.

The risk nobody chose,
and nobody is watching.

Usually, it is the operations manager. Sometimes it is the founder. Occasionally, it is a relative who is good with computers. They do their best with the time they have.

But nobody is testing the backups. Nobody patched the website last quarter. Three people may still have access they lost the right to years ago. And nobody has time to ask what could simply be automated.

Nothing looks wrong—until one morning it is. By then, it has stopped being a technical problem and become a business problem.
Request a technology review → We run the review live during the call.

04 / Ownership

Most agencies deliver projects. We take responsibility.

A project ends. Your business systems do not.

We remain responsible for the systems we build and manage. We monitor them, improve them and resolve issues before they become a problem for your team.

When something needs attention, we already know. The standard is simple: did your business run smoothly this month?

05 / How we work

Three things happen every month, whether or not anything breaks.

Good technology support is often invisible. That should not mean you are left wondering what is being done.

Every month, you receive a clear view of what is protected, what has improved and what needs attention next—written in plain business language.

08 / Before you ask

The honest answers.

We already have someone handling IT. Does that rule us out?+

No. We can work alongside an existing staff member, web developer or IT provider. In many cases, we provide the structure, oversight and wider technical support they do not have capacity to provide alone.

Do we have to change the tools we already use?+

Not unless there is a clear reason to do so. We begin by understanding what you have, then improve, secure and connect it where needed.

Are you on site, or is this remote?+

We work remotely across Ghana and West Africa. Our work focuses on your digital systems: websites, email, cloud accounts, security, automation and connected business tools. We do not provide hardware repair, office networking or cabling services.

How quickly can you start, and how disruptive is onboarding?+

We begin with a review of your current systems, access and priorities. Most onboarding happens quietly in the background, with minimal interruption to your team.

What if we want to stop?+

You can end a monthly retainer with 30 days' written notice. Your business data will be returned or securely deleted within 14 days.
